name: smwmusic-castlevania-rondo-of-blood-dracula-x-dinner-of-flames-bloodlines-scarlet-mix
title: Castlevania: Rondo of Blood / Dracula X - Dinner of Flames ~ Bloodlines (Scarlet-Mix)
description:
𝕯𝖎𝖊 𝖒𝖔𝖓𝖘𝖙𝖊𝖗. 𝖄𝖔𝖚 𝖉𝖔𝖓'𝖙 𝖇𝖊𝖑𝖔𝖓𝖌 𝖎𝖓 𝖙𝖍𝖎𝖘 𝖜𝖔𝖗𝖑𝖉!

Did a very special arrangement of best boi Richter Belmont's theme song, Divine Bloodlines, from Castlevania: Rondo Of Blood / Dracula X for my 2K subscriber milestone. This song ended up winning a poll (of 5 songs) on my YT Community Page for which song I'd do for this special.

This song... it's another one of my all-time favorite VGMs. It's intense, heroic, catchy, dark, etc. I hope to god somebody plays this at my funeral whenever I pass away in the FAR future.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. C# Minor (M&K Company Pitch)
3. D Minor (Custom Pitch)
